sentences.en: The barn has been stylishly renovated to an exceptionally high standard, and benefits from glorious views over the rural Devon countryside.

sentences.en: They are also stylishly housed in a compact silver cabinet and comes with a tabletop stand.

sentences.en: Most biker goggles are stylishly designed, frequently with leather or chrome accents that compliment popular biking attire.

sentences.en: In fact, medium lengths are often the most versatile of any, and can be stylishly coifed as bobs, updos, with layers or bangs, braided, or curled.

sentences.en: For the woman who may not want the bareness of a bikini, but still prefers a two-piece bathing suit, tankinis by Christina will keep you stylishly outfitted for summertime fun.
